title: What If Earth Had No Tilt and There Were No Seasons?

scenes.text: What if Earth stood perfectly upright? No summer, no winter. Just one season, forever.
Earth leans 23.4 degrees, and that lean is the reason we have seasons. Straighten it and they disappear.
Every place would keep the same weather and the same day length all year long.
The poles would stay in permanent cold, while the Sun would sit directly overhead at the equator.
Wheat, corn, potatoes and barley grow best with cold winters, so food production would likely drop sharply.
Hibernation, migration, tree rings: the clocks nature runs on would stop.

description:
What if Earth had no axial tilt?
There would be no seasons, constant weather at every latitude, and crops that need cold winters would struggle.
What should we run through next?
